title: RIC-401 Appendix F — Artifact Schema (ERD)
subtitle: Entity model for taxonomy artifacts. Versioning, lineage, hypothesis annotation, authority + dimension assignment. The schema underlies every appendix above.

nodes.label:
ARTIFACT SCHEMA — every node in the Katalyst taxonomy carries these fields.
Lineage (supersedes), authority (owner role), dimension (Need / Design Intent / Implementation Reality), and hypothesis annotation are the four load-bearing relationships.

Artifact
──────────────
• id (PK)
• type (UT | US | ADR | NFR | PRD | mockup | ...)
• title
• version (semver-ish: 1.0, 1.1, 2.0)
• status (DRAFT | APPROVED | SUPERSEDED | DEPRECATED)
• created_at
• last_modified
• supersedes_id (FK → Artifact.id, nullable)
• dimension_id (FK → TaxonomyDimension.id)
• loop_id (FK → Loop.id)
• owner_authority_id (FK → Authority.id)
• hypothesis_id (FK → Hypothesis.id, nullable)
• body (markdown / yaml content)

Hypothesis
──────────────
• id (PK)
• claim ("we believe X")
• success_metrics ("right when Y")
• kill_criteria ("by date Z")
• status (DRAFT | ACTIVE | CONFIRMED | REFUTED | PARTIAL | EXTRACTED | KILLED | REFINED)
• created_at
• decided_at (nullable until terminal state)
• evidence_refs[] (FK → Evidence.id)
• loop_id (FK → Loop.id)
• owner_authority_id (FK → Authority.id)
• related_artifact_ids[] (FK → Artifact.id)

Evidence
──────────────
• id (PK)
• type (interview | metric | observation | analytics | survey)
• date
• summary
• ref_url (link to source: dashboard, transcript, report)
• hypothesis_id (FK → Hypothesis.id)
• collected_by_authority_id (FK → Authority.id)

HypothesisOutcome (annotation)
──────────────
• id (PK)
• hypothesis_id (FK → Hypothesis.id)
• status (CONFIRMED | REFUTED | PARTIAL)
• date
• evidence_refs[] (FK → Evidence.id)
• rationale (markdown)
• append-only (never updated, only appended)
• triggered_extraction_id (FK → Pattern.id, nullable)

TaxonomyDimension
──────────────
• id (PK)
• name (Need | Design Intent | Implementation Reality)
• description
• existing Forge node types[]

Loop
──────────────
• id (PK)
• name (Outer | Inner | Hypothesis)
• cadence (quarters-years | days-weeks | always-on)
• description

Authority
──────────────
• id (PK)
• role (Leadership | Mission Stakeholder | PM | HCD Lead | HCD Expert | UX | Architect | Engineer | Research | Data Analyst)
• decision_domain (markdown)
• loop_id (FK → Loop.id)
• replaceable_by_AI (bool — false for HCD)

Pattern (extracted)
──────────────
• id (PK)
• name
• shape (component | token | IA | interaction | copy)
• source_artifact_ids[] (FK → Artifact.id, ≥2)
• extracted_at
• extracted_by_authority_id (FK → Authority.id)
• design_system_version_at_merge

INVARIANTS
• Artifact.supersedes_id → forms a DAG (no cycles); old artifact stays as historical record
• Artifact.status = SUPERSEDED iff another Artifact.supersedes_id = this.id
• Hypothesis.status terminal-state (CONFIRMED/REFUTED/PARTIAL) requires ≥1 HypothesisOutcome record
• HypothesisOutcome is append-only — outcome history is immutable
• Pattern.source_artifact_ids requires ≥2 entries (one-off ≠ pattern)
• Authority.replaceable_by_AI = false for HCD Expert (Aaron's directive)
• Artifact.dimension_id and loop_id are required (no orphans)

Why this schema? Because the taxonomy must be MACHINE-READABLE at agent speed.
Prose-only artifacts collapse into the human-speed slide-deck failure mode.
A structured schema is the precondition for any tooling (`kata-design lint`, hypothesis-status CLI, pattern-extraction proposals) recommended in §11.
